reviews.title: Full of adverts and crashes
reviews.text: The adverts take up the whole screen. Don’t demonstrate a time period for watching. Tried to save a location and the app crashed.

reviews.title: Seaford
reviews.text: Terrible, it isn’t on the list

reviews.title: Oh dear!
reviews.text:
Sadly this once brilliant app is no longer fit for purpose. 
I can understand that the developer needs revenue to keep an app up to date but a) the adverts are seriously long and more importantly b) there is no data when I do get past the ads!

reviews.title: Adverts
reviews.text: Just had an advert that told me my phone was locked. Luckily I am technically skilled but some people would not be and would have pressed on a scam advert. Very poor

reviews.title: Was good… but went bad
reviews.text: This was a great app circa 2020 till 2023 ish. But I assume the builder lost funding or focus and now it’s never updated whether that’s local details or security fixes to keep it live on the App Store. I know how hard it is to keep an app going, so no shade. But the builder should remove this one as it is now very out of date and functionality not working.

reviews.title: App has stopped working altogether
reviews.text: For every single location offered, I get a single date of 1st January and tide times of 1am and 1pm at 0.00m.  Not very handy while in the middle of June summer heatwave when I am holidaying at the beach

reviews.title: Adverts
reviews.text: The adverts are really annoying. I now go to free sites like BBC who do not have adverts.
